description:
Create a new API key. The secret key value is returned ONLY in this response — store it securely. Note: the secret will be visible in the AI conversation context. Optionally bind the key to a sub-account via profile_id — outbound messages sent with the key are then branded as that sub-account. Optionally give it an end date with expires_at (ISO 8601 with offset, at least 5 minutes ahead); leave it out and the key never expires. Ask the user when the key should stop working rather than choosing for them. A date in the past or less than 5 minutes ahead is refused (validation_error) and nothing is created.

Agent usage: This operation requires 2FA bound to the key it creates — its environment, scopes, sub-account and end date: a code confirmed for one key does not create another. (1) Call create_api_key with what the user chose; nothing is created, and its 2fa_required refusal lists the exact targets for that key. (2) Call start_2fa with action_type "api_key_create" and exactly those targets (none if the refusal lists none); the user is shown the key they are approving. (3) Wait for the user to verify the code and poll get_2fa_status until "verified". (4) Call create_api_key again with the SAME arguments. One code creates one key.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account, signed in: call start_login, show the user its challenge, then wait_for_login, then call this tool again. An API key alone does NOT open this tool.

expires_at.description: When the key stops working, ISO 8601 with offset (e.g. 2027-02-13T23:59:59+01:00), at least 5 minutes ahead. Omit for a key that never expires.

profile_id.description: Bind the new key to a sub-account you own (24-hex id). Immutable after creation; omit for an unbound account-wide key.

name: create_api_key

outputSchema.description: A newly created or regenerated API key, with its full value — the one response that carries it.

expires_at.description: When the key stops working. Present when the key has an expiry: the one asked for at creation; on a regenerated key the one asked for while regenerating, else the old key's instant, carried over. Absent on a key that never expires.

key.description: The full API key. Returned only in this response; it cannot be read again.

profile_id.description: Sub-account (PublicProfile) the key is bound to; null for unbound keys.
